defaults._needsReview_comment: pa11y's axe runner defaults levelCapWhenNeedsReview to 'error', promoting axe's INCOMPLETE results (could-not-determine, e.g. text partially clipped by an overflow-x container — flaky per run because it depends on scroll/paint state) to hard failures. Cap them at 'warning' so they stay visible in the log without failing the gate; genuine axe VIOLATIONS are unaffected and still fail.
defaults._exemptions_comment: No per-URL ignore/hideElements. /quiet-corners/ carried a rule-wide color-contrast ignore from 2026-07-30 citing a methodology <summary> block that #314 deleted; measured 2026-09-04 without it (3 runs, built site, this config) the page reports 0 errors. The three remaining color-contrast items (the zoom-out control's aria-hidden minus glyph and the Leaflet attribution link, under #qc-map) are axe needs-review results the cap above already holds at warning. Any exemption added back must carry an _ignore_comment naming elements that exist: scripts/test_a11y_config.py checks it.
